university.name: University of Bristol
university.summary: Public research university in the city of Bristol offering undergraduate, postgraduate taught and research degrees. It publishes a Pakistan country page setting out accepted Pakistani qualifications for undergraduate and postgraduate entry, and runs an International Foundation Programme for students who need a preparatory year before degree study.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor: listed as University of Bristol, Bristol, Higher Education Institution (HEI), Student Sponsor - Track Record, Student route (gov.uk register dated 2026-10-07)

courses.title: BSc Computer Science (G400)
courses.overview: A three year honours degree in computer science, UCAS code G400, combining programming and theory with later options in areas such as high performance computing, machine learning, cryptography and artificial intelligence.
courses.academic_requirements: A-level standard offer A*AA including A* in Mathematics (contextual offer AAB including A in Mathematics). IB: 38 points overall with 18 at Higher Level, including 7 at Higher Level in Mathematics.
courses.english_requirements: Profile level E: IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in all skills; PTE Academic 67 overall with no skill below 64; TOEFL iBT 88 overall (Reading 20, Listening 19, Speaking 22, Writing 22) for tests taken up to 20 January 2026, or 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills on the new scale.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The University's Pakistan page states that applicants with the HSSC with an overall average of 75% and a Bachelor (Pass) degree with a minimum of 60% are considered for undergraduate entry. HSSC alone is not listed for direct entry; A-level and IB holders are considered for direct admission, and the International Foundation Programme is the stated preparatory route.
courses.notes: Fee is published as GBP 34,700 for the first year for international students on the 2027 entry page; later years may differ. English test detail taken from the Profile E page (https://www.bristol.ac.uk/study/language-requirements/profile-e/). min_toefl left null because TOEFL moved to a new scoring scale in January 2026 and both scales are accepted. Duolingo is not listed as accepted.

courses.title: LLB Law (M100)
courses.overview: A three year law degree, UCAS code M100, with specialist units such as corporate governance, international law, commercial law and environmental law. The University states it prepares students in part for the Solicitors Qualifying Examination. Applicants must sit the LNAT.
courses.academic_requirements: A-level standard offer A*AA. IB: 38 points overall with 18 at Higher Level. Applicants are required to take the LNAT.
courses.english_requirements: Profile level B (undergraduate): IELTS 7.0 overall with 7.0 in Writing and 6.5 in all other skills; PTE Academic 71 overall with at least 71 in Writing and 67 in all other skills; TOEFL iBT 95 overall (Reading 22, Listening 21, Speaking 23, Writing 24) for tests taken up to 20 January 2026, or 5 overall, 5 in Writing and 4.5 in other skills on the new scale.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The University's Pakistan page states that applicants with the HSSC with an overall average of 75% and a Bachelor (Pass) degree with a minimum of 60% are considered for undergraduate entry. HSSC alone is not listed for direct entry; A-level and IB holders are considered for direct admission.
courses.notes: Fee is published as GBP 26,500 for the first year for international students on the 2027 entry page. English test detail taken from the Profile B page (https://www.bristol.ac.uk/study/language-requirements/profile-b/); min_ielts_band records the lowest component (6.5), with Writing at 7.0. min_toefl left null because of the January 2026 TOEFL scale change.

courses.title: Mechanical Engineering (MEng)
courses.overview: A four year integrated master's in mechanical engineering, UCAS code H300, built around design and manufacture, dynamics and control, materials, and energy and fluid flow.
courses.academic_requirements: A-level standard offer A*AA, including A*A (in any order) in Mathematics and one of Further Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science. IB: 38 points overall with 18 at Higher Level, including 7 and 6 (in any order) at Higher Level in Mathematics and a second required subject.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in all skills (Profile level E); PTE Academic 67 overall with no skill below 64.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The University's Pakistan page states that applicants with the HSSC with an overall average of 75% and a Bachelor (Pass) degree with a minimum of 60% are considered for undergraduate entry. HSSC alone is not listed for direct entry; A-level and IB holders are considered for direct admission.
courses.notes: Fee is published as GBP 33,600 for the first year for international students on the 2027 entry page. The IB second subject wording was not read in full; the A-level subject list is as published. PTE figure from the Profile E page.

courses.title: BSc Economics (L100)
courses.overview: A three year economics degree, UCAS code L100, covering micro and macroeconomics and quantitative methods, with later options including behavioural economics, machine learning, health economics and international trade.
courses.academic_requirements: A-level standard offer A*AA including Mathematics (contextual offer AAB including Mathematics). IB: 38 points overall with 18 at Higher Level, including Mathematics.
courses.english_requirements: Profile level G: IELTS 6.5 overall with 7.0 in reading and listening, and no score below 6.0.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The University's Pakistan page states that applicants with the HSSC with an overall average of 75% and a Bachelor (Pass) degree with a minimum of 60% are considered for undergraduate entry. HSSC alone is not listed for direct entry; A-level and IB holders are considered for direct admission.
courses.notes: Fee is published as GBP 29,300 for the first year for international students on the 2027 entry page. Profile G page not opened, so PTE and TOEFL equivalents are not recorded.

courses.title: MSc Management
courses.overview: A one year master's at the University of Bristol Business School for graduates of any discipline, covering management and organisation, finance and accounting for managers, strategy and decision making, and leadership and change.
courses.academic_requirements: Upper second-class honours degree or an international equivalent in any discipline.
courses.english_requirements: Profile level B (postgraduate): IELTS 7.0 overall and 6.5 in all skills; PTE Academic 71 overall and at least 67 in all skills; TOEFL iBT 95 overall (Reading 22, Listening 21, Speaking 23, Writing 22) for tests taken up to 20 January 2026, or 5 overall and 4.5 in all skills on the new scale.
courses.experience_requirements: Not required for standard entry. Applicants below the grade requirement may be more likely to receive an offer with at least five years of relevant work experience or a relevant postgraduate qualification, with a CV.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The University's Pakistan page considers a 4 year bachelor's (or a 3 year bachelor's plus a 1 year master's, a 2 year bachelor's plus a 2 year master's, or a 4 year bachelor's awarded before 2016 plus a 1 year master's) from accepted Pakistani universities, and states that a CGPA of at least 3.7 is required for programmes with a UK 2:1 requirement. The CGPA scale is not stated. Only qualifications from selected Pakistani institutions are considered, and a Qualification Check verification is required before a CAS is issued.
courses.application_deadline_note: Overseas applicants: 12 August 2027. Places are allocated on a continuous basis and programmes may close early.
courses.notes: Page shows September 2027 entry with an overseas fee of GBP 34,500 per year. English test detail from the Profile B page (https://www.bristol.ac.uk/study/language-requirements/profile-b/). pk_min_cgpa left null because the Pakistan page does not state the scale of the 3.7 CGPA figure.

courses.title: MSc Data Science
courses.overview: A one year master's in data science covering large scale data engineering, artificial intelligence and text analytics, visual analytics, and the place of technology in business and society.
courses.academic_requirements: A strong upper second-class honours degree (65% or higher) or an international equivalent in a numerate science, computer science or engineering. Other accepted subjects include accounting, architecture, biology, chemistry, econometrics, economics, finance, medicine, operations research, physics and psychology, among others listed.
courses.english_requirements: Profile level C: IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.5 in all skills; PTE Academic 67 overall with no skill below 67; TOEFL iBT 88 overall (Reading 22, Listening 21, Speaking 23, Writing 22) for tests taken up to 20 January 2026, or 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills on the new scale.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The University's Pakistan page considers a 4 year bachelor's (or listed bachelor's plus master's combinations) from accepted Pakistani universities, with a CGPA of at least 3.7 for programmes with a UK 2:1 requirement and higher grades for programmes with a higher requirement. This programme asks for a strong 2:1 (65%), so the Pakistani CGPA needed may be above 3.7; the page gives no figure.
courses.notes: Page shows September 2027 entry with an overseas fee of GBP 37,900 per year. English test detail from the Profile C page (https://www.bristol.ac.uk/study/language-requirements/profile-c/).

courses.title: MSc Public Health
courses.overview: A one year master's in public health covering epidemiology, statistics, research methods and health economics, for graduates in health, life science and social science subjects.
courses.academic_requirements: Upper second-class honours degree or an international equivalent in a listed subject, including anthropology, biology, biomedical science, dentistry, epidemiology, geography, global health, health economics, medicine, nursing, pharmacology, physiotherapy, psychology, sociology, statistics or veterinary science.
courses.english_requirements: Profile level C: IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.5 in all skills; PTE Academic 67 overall with no skill below 67; TOEFL iBT 88 overall (Reading 22, Listening 21, Speaking 23, Writing 22) for tests taken up to 20 January 2026, or 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills on the new scale.
courses.experience_requirements: Not required for standard entry. Applicants with a final grade slightly below the requirement may be more likely to receive an offer with at least one year of relevant paid work (for example as an information or data analyst, public health practitioner or research assistant) or a relevant postgraduate qualification.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The University's Pakistan page considers a 4 year bachelor's (or listed bachelor's plus master's combinations) from accepted Pakistani universities, and states that a CGPA of at least 3.7 is required for programmes with a UK 2:1 requirement. The CGPA scale is not stated.
courses.notes: Page shows September 2027 entry with an overseas full-time fee of GBP 31,200 per year. English test detail from the Profile C page.

scholarships.name: Think Big Undergraduate Scholarships
scholarships.value_text: GBP 6,500 or GBP 13,000 towards tuition fees, for up to four years (2026 entry terms)
scholarships.summary: Competitive tuition fee awards for overseas fee status applicants to eligible undergraduate programmes, with further subject specific versions in business, economics, policy studies, chemistry, physics and veterinary science. Applicants use a single scholarship form after applying to the University.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee status and an application to an eligible undergraduate programme; Dental School and Medical School courses excluded. An application ID is needed; an offer is not.
scholarships.deadline_note: 2026 entry round opened 21 October 2025 and closed at 10:00 UK time on 10 April 2026. 2027 entry dates not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Only September 2026 entry terms are published and that round is closed; 2027 terms not yet published. value_amount left null because two tiers are published. Subject versions: Business (GBP 6,500), Economics (GBP 6,500), Policy Studies (GBP 13,000), Science and Engineering for Chemistry or Physics BSc (GBP 6,500), Veterinary Science (GBP 6,500, three years only). The general Think Big page (https://www.bristol.ac.uk/students/support/finances/scholarships/think-big-scholarships/) does not state the number of awards or how funds are paid.

scholarships.name: Think Big Postgraduate Scholarships
scholarships.value_text: GBP 6,500, GBP 13,000 or GBP 26,000 towards tuition fees, for one year of study (2026 entry terms)
scholarships.summary: Competitive tuition fee awards for overseas fee status applicants to eligible master's programmes, including MRes, with further school and programme specific versions across business, economics, education, law, public policy, social sciences, translation and science and engineering.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee status and an application to an eligible master's programme. An application ID is needed; an offer is not. Cannot be held with the Think Big Career Accelerator.
scholarships.deadline_note: 2026 entry round opened 21 October 2025, with early consideration to 14 January 2026 and a final deadline of 10:00 UK time on 10 April 2026. 2027 entry dates not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Only September 2026 entry terms are published and that round is closed; 2027 terms not yet published. value_amount left null because three tiers are published. Subject versions listed for 2026 include Business, Comparative Literatures and Cultures, Conflict Resolution and Peacebuilding, Economics, Education, International Development, International Relations, Law and Justice, Nutrition, Physical Activity and Public Health, Public Policy, Research (master's by research), Sociology, Science and Engineering, and Translation and Interpreting, with values of GBP 6,500 or GBP 13,000.

scholarships.name: Think Big Career Accelerator
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,000 towards tuition fees plus a place on a careers programme (2026 entry terms)
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee award for overseas fee status students on eligible one year master's programmes, combined with a place on a careers development programme. Additional places are reserved for some schools and centres.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee status and an application to an eligible master's programme; in 2026 all one year master's programmes, including MRes, were eligible. Cannot be held with a Think Big postgraduate scholarship.
scholarships.deadline_note: 2026 entry round closed at 10:00 UK time on 10 April 2026. 2027 entry dates not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Only September 2026 entry terms are published and that round is closed; 2027 terms not yet published.

scholarships.name: Michael Wong Pakshong bursary
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,000 living costs bursary, one award (2026 entry terms)
scholarships.summary: A single living costs bursary for an overseas fee status student starting a one year taught master's in selected schools of the Faculty of Arts, Law and Social Sciences.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee status; applying for a full-time one year taught master's in the School of Economics, Education, Policy Studies, Sociology, Politics and International Studies, the Business School or the Law School.
scholarships.deadline_note: 2026 entry round closed at 10:00 UK time on 10 April 2026. 2027 entry dates not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Only September 2026 entry terms are published and that round is closed; 2027 terms not yet published. One award only. Uses the same single scholarship form as the Think Big awards.

scholarships.name: Alumni discount
scholarships.value_text: 25% reduction in tuition fees for the full length of the programme
scholarships.summary: An automatic tuition fee discount for Bristol graduates who return for an eligible postgraduate taught or research degree and pay at least part of their fees themselves.
scholarships.criteria_text: Bristol undergraduate or integrated master's graduates starting an eligible postgraduate programme, or Bristol taught postgraduate graduates starting a research degree, in 2027/28. Applies only to the self-funded portion. PG Certificates, PG Diplomas, PGCE and modular programmes excluded.
scholarships.deadline_note: No application or deadline; the discount appears on the financial statement after registration.
scholarships.notes: Page covers students starting in 2027/28. Cannot be combined with the Staff Discount for the same degree. Relevant mainly to existing or former Bristol students.
